entries.0e0a6be8168d68d6: Pharmaceutical companies (out-licensing counterparties for development, manufacturing and marketing rights)
entries.51291b8fbd179a3e: A single-segment business focused on developing new cancer immunotherapy drugs. Originating from research on cancer peptide vaccines, the business currently develops multiple pipeline candidates from exploratory research to early clinical trial stages, centered on iPS cell-derived cell therapies and antibody drugs. Developed drug candidates are licensed out to pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas, and the model generates licensing income. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥84 thousand.
entries.67acfd73f2b35750: A single-segment business focused on developing new cancer immunotherapy drugs.
entries.903a648ddaf4d70b: As antibody drugs that bind to immune checkpoint molecules and immunoregulatory molecules that suppress immune function in tumor tissue and inhibit their function, the company is developing BP1212, an anti-CD39 × anti-TIM-3 bispecific antibody, and BP1223, a T cell engager targeting CD39 and CD3.
entries.be3ebccbf7764e91: The company is developing BP2201, a regenerative NKT cell therapy using iPS cell-derived NKT cells, BP2202, a BCMA CAR-NKT cell therapy targeting multiple myeloma, and BP2301, a CAR-T cell therapy targeting HER2.
entries.e7be57fe1a2690f0: The company is developing BP2201, a regenerative NKT cell therapy using iPS cell-derived NKT cells, BP2202, a BCMA CAR-NKT cell therapy targeting multiple myeloma, and BP2301, a CAR-T cell therapy targeting HER2. The company plans to conduct clinical trials in the United States for BP2202 from fiscal 2026.
